entities.name: Mira Topić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mira Topić is a Croatian female volleyball player, playing as an outside-spiker. She is part of the Croatia women's national volleyball team. She competed at the 2015 Women's European Volleyball Championship. On club level she plays for Impel Breslavia.
